title: Reuse block for spec-registry entries (ADR-18 Prior-Art & Reuse Gate)
description: Optional per-entry block in FLOSS/docs/specs/spec-registry.json. Required (fail-closed) for entries with tier 1 or 2, unless emergency=true, in which case it is required before promotion/generalization.

capability.description: One-sentence statement of the capability being introduced.

search_date.description: Date of the prior-art search (YYYY-MM-DD). Evidence older than evidence_window_days fails --check.

probe.description: Result of a direct probe, or 'not_probed: <reason>'. Tier-2 compose/build verdicts require >=1 probed candidate.

irreducible_delta.description: What remains custom, stated as capability subtraction; <=5 sentences; must be testable.

rejected_because.description: Requirement-by-candidate gaps, each carrying its truth status inline.

reviewer.description: Tier 2: reviewing surface + model family, distinct from proposer's family. Use voter profile 'reuse-review'.

expiry_or_retest_date.description: Mirrors ADR-17 open-review fields; re-scan trigger.
